classification_rules.STRUCTURAL: PK/FK, verified join endpoint or discriminator; admits key shape only, not relationship meaning. Semantic-bearing literal keys may remain held.
classification_rules.QUALIFIED: Existing field-level evidence establishes definition, applicable unit, grain, temporal basis and accounting/population basis within admission_scope.
classification_rules.UNRESOLVED: Field-specific evidence/assessment exists but a required semantic dimension remains open.
classification_rules.NOT_ASSESSED: Dictionary inventories storage but supplied evidence does not complete a field-specific Gate-A assessment.
classification_rules.NOT_APPLICABLE: Operational, provenance, media-workflow or technical control; no LOOM-universe descriptive claim.

caveats: Table-level dictionary recovery labels and Phase 2B table dispositions never qualify all columns.
Ceres MVP-A qualifications are limited to recorded consumed rows/identities unless separately qualified by system-wide field evidence.
STRUCTURAL is a candidate classification, not authorization to import unresolved semantic-bearing key values.
Source presence is not model capability or canon authority. Original SQLite remains outside PostgreSQL.
Navigator, campaign and media require separate inventories and are not counted among these 95 tables.
